profile.name: resource_unnormalized_per_party_100_down_40_up
profile.network: local TCP payload pacing, distinct parties, no installed RTT/loss emulator

client_high_water.post_serialization_scope: RUSAGE_SELF birth through post-serialization atexit observation; excludes later receipt serialization/interpreter teardown
client_high_water.tier_rule: unchanged ordinary process.peak_rss maximum across accepted fresh workers

ordinary_network_reconciliation.comparison: monotone counters bracketed by measured read intervals

scope.archive_qualification: per-trial reference, manifest, receipts and ordinary-envelope reconciliation; not cohort qualification
scope.child_census: spawn-bound known providers plus sampled undeclared-descendant checks during serving; not an OS fork audit
scope.excludes: process startup before observer; final receipt serialization and later interpreter teardown
scope.phase_boundaries: synchronous counter/RSS snapshot completion; observer overhead included
scope.provenance: local consistency receipts, not remote worker authentication; dependencies use ordinary parent build inspection
scope.qualification: observation structure only; archive receipts and ordinary envelope require load_trace
scope.supported_graph: one native client with two prepared providers and optionally two boundary providers; one cold response
